claim: Professionshøjskolen Absalon, formerly University College Sjælland, received positive institutional accreditation on 3 June 2021.
excerpt: The authority records positive institutional accreditation on 3 June 2021 and identifies the earlier name University College Sjælland.

claim: The full-degree hub lists Biotechnology, Robot Systems and Education as three programmes taught fully or partly in English.
excerpt: University College Absalon offers a range of bachelor programmes, including three programmes taught fully or partly in English. The listed choices are Biotechnology, Robot Systems and Education.

claim: The 2021 Campus Kalundborg has a small international study environment and lists Biotechnology and Robot Systems.
excerpt: Campus Kalundborg is a brand new campus from 2021. [...] You will be part of a small, international [...] study environment where we know and help each other.

claim: Biotechnology retains its subject prerequisites, quota 2 interview and 65/35 quota split; current English alternatives include the new TOEFL scale.
excerpt: Mathematics A; Physics B or Geoscience A; Chemistry B or Biotechnology A; English B. Quota 2 interview assesses academic qualifications, English and motivation. Other criteria include exam results, work, courses and documented qualifications. TOEFL 4.5 (94 before 21 January 2026), IELTS 6.5 or Cambridge 180; tests no older than two years.

claim: Robot Systems now publishes a quota 1 GPA floor of 5.0 on the Danish scale and quota 2 interview ranking, with 65/35 places.
excerpt: Quota 1 ranks by GPA, at least 5.0 Danish scale. Quota 2 ranks interview test scores; interviewing is optional when the quota 1 GPA requirement is met. Other assessment criteria name grades, work, relevant courses and documented qualifications. Required subjects remain Mathematics A, Physics B or Geoscience A, English B. English alternatives: TOEFL 4.5 (94 before 21 January 2026), IELTS 6.5, Cambridge 180, within two years.
interpretation: Supersedes the September reading that criteria were not finalised and a video might be requested. The page still also says applicants may be asked for an interview; do not turn the quota 2 interview into a universal mandatory interview.

claim: Current published fee guidance exempts EU/EEA citizens and normally charges other applicants DKK 3,750 application deposit plus tuition; rates are undated for the target intake.
excerpt: EU/EEA citizens need not pay tuition. Application deposit DKK 3,750, before assessment; not refunded unless admitted, then deducted from tuition. First-year tuition in advance from September 2026. Published table: DKK 81,578.14 per semester in semesters 1–5 and 7; DKK 10,833.75 in semester 6; total DKK 500,302.58. Fees may change.
interpretation: The page gives no price year for this table. Do not label the rates confirmed for 2027.

claim: Current published fee guidance exempts EU/EEA citizens and normally charges other applicants DKK 3,750 application deposit plus tuition; rates are undated for the target intake.
excerpt: EU/EEA citizens need not pay tuition. Application deposit DKK 3,750, before assessment; not refunded unless admitted, then deducted from tuition. First-year tuition in advance from September 2026. Published table: DKK 81,578.14 per semester in semesters 1–5 and 7; DKK 10,833.75 in semester 6; total DKK 500,302.58. Fees may change.
interpretation: The fee page copies the low-fee sixth semester, but Robot Systems places the internship in semester five. Preserve the published total as an undated quote, not a guaranteed 2027 price or corrected schedule.

claim: IB applicants apply through Optagelse by 15 March noon; EU summer finishers must declare completion and monitor nemStudie document requests.
excerpt: IB is an international exam even when taken in Denmark. Apply by 15 March at noon. Required documentation is due then, with missing items subject to individual nemStudie deadlines. EU summer finishers should state this in the application. 5 July is the application deadline only for Danish-exam applicants.
interpretation: Published annual days/months lack a 2027 cycle label. Supplementary route milestones are provisional. Biotechnology application page states the same rule.

claim: The engineering FAQ allows later exam evidence and describes the preliminary-results procedure; the programme-specific instructions still control individual requests.
excerpt: Exam evidence may be documented by 5 July at noon. If completion is later but before 1 September, say so and attach preliminary results and expected-subject-hours verification before 5 July. IB exams are generally exempt from the subject-hours verification form. Offers arrive via nemStudie.
interpretation: Robot Systems links to this engineering FAQ. Its generic completion rule does not explicitly resolve same-year non-EU admission against the application page’s EU-specific summer concession. Do not promise that route to fee-paying summer finishers.
